title.narrative: Supporting Cambodia’s first trade under Article 6.2 of the Paris Agreement

description.narrative: GGGI supported the Cambodian government in building capacity on Article 6 of the Paris Agreement through the MATS project, funded by the Swedish Energy Agency. The project focused on training key government bodies, including the Department of Climate Change and the Inter-Ministerial Technical Working Group. Although the project ended in June 2023, GGGI continues to assist the Ministry of Environment and private sector entities in understanding carbon markets. A key outcome was the Prime Minister's endorsement of the Operational Manual for Article 6 implementation, strengthening Cambodia’s readiness for carbon trading.Cambodia’s first potential carbon trade under Article 6, in partnership with Korea, is the “ITMO project for Charging Infrastructure through E-mobility Promotion,” led by electric two-wheeler company VERYWORDS. GGGI will continue to provide technical support to both the Ministry of Environment in Cambodia and MOTIE in Korea ensuring alignment of processes with the Article 6 Operations Manual. GGGI will also support the government in building it's policies and monitoring system to ensure proper utilization of the e-scooters deployed trough the project.
